title: Marvel — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Marvel.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Scotch Engineered." Premium tier. Marvel (Middleby) makes undercounter and full-size refrigeration for residential applications. Known for professional-grade undercounter units, wine storage, and beverage centers.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Undercounter refrigeration needs. Wine enthusiasts. Entertainment areas.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Marvel:

• Professional-grade undercounter refrigeration

• Middleby quality backing

• Wide selection of wine and beverage storage

• Dynamic Cooling Technology for consistent temperatures

• Close-door assist for seamless integration
